versions.subject: Create win_susp_krbrelayup.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 3
    AuthenticationPackageName: 'Kerberos'
    IpAddress: '127.0.0.1'
condition: selection

versions.subject: refactor: tightened krbrelayup rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 3
    AuthenticationPackageName: 'Kerberos'
    IpAddress: '127.0.0.1'
    TargetUserSid|startswith: 'S-1-5-21-'
    TargetUserSid|endswith: '-500'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=4624 LogonType=3 AuthenticationPackageName="Kerberos" IpAddress="127.0.0.1" TargetUserSid="S-1-5-21-*" TargetUserSid="*-500"
